detailed_descriptions.en: Help Zirian save his sister from the claws of Despair by restoring the fabric of time and uncovering the secrets of the Master Clockmakers . Master a seamless blend of dynamic platforming and fast-paced combat . Jump, dash, grapple, and glide your way through thrilling challenges that rekindle the magic of classic action platformer favourites. Explore stunning realms shaped by the Master Clockmakers , each f illed with mystery, magic, breathtaking vistas , and endearing characters. Navigate ethereal forests, underwater realms, sunlit dunes and cloudy heights - the world of Duskfade is alive and teems with secrets for you to uncover. Experience a powerful coming-of-age journey filled with heart , loss, and the courage to face the unknown. Join a cast of charming characters to face down long forgotten foes, each embodying an emotional hurdle.

detailed_descriptions_html.en:
Help Zirian save his sister from the claws of Despair by restoring the fabric of time and uncovering the secrets of the Master Clockmakers.

Master a seamless blend of dynamic platforming and fast-paced combat. Jump, dash, grapple, and glide your way through thrilling challenges that rekindle the magic of classic action platformer favourites. 

Explore stunning realms shaped by the Master Clockmakers, each filled with mystery, magic, breathtaking vistas, and endearing characters. Navigate ethereal forests, underwater realms, sunlit dunes and cloudy heights - the world of Duskfade is alive and teems with secrets for you to uncover.

Experience a powerful coming-of-age journey filled with heart, loss, and the courage to face the unknown. Join a cast of charming characters to face down long forgotten foes, each embodying an emotional hurdle.
